verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Mailchimp publishes Marketing and Transactional API reference pages with endpoint descriptions and request lines such as `GET https://api.mailchimp.com/3.0/`. Nothing shows the reference is interactive: no try-it console, playground, or runnable examples. A static reference is only adjacent to this story, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
